task.description: The address of the task, for example @v1/nuucognition/task.dev/<id>#ops. The task does not exist at the open: set it after Stage 1 with flint shard invocations set-input <id> task=<address>.

next.interactive: Look for an open task with the same intent first. Create the task with flint shard task task-new and a body file of the note. Then set the input to the field ops of its output: flint shard invocations set-input {{invocation}} task=<address>.
next.headless: Set the phase creating-task. Look for an open task with the same intent first. Create the task with flint shard task task-new and a body file of the note from the prompt. Then set the input to the field ops of its output: flint shard invocations set-input {{invocation}} task=<address>.

steps.title: Placement
steps.next: Place {{task}} with sk-task-place_task: a given place wins; one clear hint sets the home; two or more hints add a related link each; no hint leaves the task unplaced.

next.interactive: Give the person the title, the type, the place, and the task note of {{task}}. Write each change of the content into the note until the person confirms.
next.headless: Check the task note of {{task}} yourself: it must read as a complete task. When the scope is not clear, use a deferred request.

next.interactive: For a task.dev with a complete scope, set the stage: ops task stage {{task}} scoped. Then run flint shard task task-sync {{task}}, and close the invocation: flint shard invocations close {{invocation}} --outcome done.
next.headless: For a task.dev with a complete scope, set the stage: ops task stage {{task}} scoped. Run flint shard task task-sync {{task}}. Close the invocation: flint shard invocations close {{invocation}} --outcome done. Put the do_task command of the close in the result. When no parent frame is open, return with flint orbh session return --finish. When the close prints back in: (a parent frame is open), do not return: continue the parent frame.

behaviours.say: The input task is empty: no task is recorded. Set it with flint shard invocations set-input {{invocation}} task=<address>, or close the invocation with --outcome abandoned.
